g.text: EleanorRank6Convo2 begins.
Hey. Need to bounce some ideas off you.

Thinking about Fiendsnight. I haven’t dressed up for it for years, but I was leafing through one of Amir’s comics and I suddenly thought - hold on, I could be the Contessa! I’ve got the fangs for it and everything!
But is that too obvious? Should I be Dandy Damage?
Who's Dandy Damage?
You could always dress up as the Lotus, if you wanted to confuse people.
… you’re going to have to tell me what Fiendsnight is.
Oh mate.
Oh Gods no. I've seen her in your head. I could never do her justice.
Mmm. I forget you're an innocent abroad, sometimes.
Dandy Damage walked so that Temple and the Rippers could run. He was every mother's nightmare and every teenage catastrophe's dream.
And that helmet. Is it a helmet? Is it part of her? How does she see through it?
Fiendsnight celebrates the fading of Sol's influence on the world.
Built like a stick insect, made up like a silent movie queen. Mouth like candy. Pinstripes and leather and dog chain. Cheekbones like a skeleton's hips.
Anyway, there's three of her in the one body. I could never pick one of them over the others.
Which doesn't make a lot of sense on the face of it. Why celebrate the rising dark? Why rejoice in lawlessness and anarchy?
Dressing up in costumes? Partying? In a war zone? Do you really think that's going to happen?
You know, Fiendsnight sounds a lot like Naberus. People like to dress up for that, too.
I think it's like an inoculation, maybe. A tiny bit of the thing we fear, to strengthen us. Or maybe it's just an excuse to put on the devil's mask and raise hell.
... I'm probably just being silly. Childish. Aren't I?
Oh, what am I thinking.
I don't need to dress up, do I? I'm already a monster. Forever and ever.
Check boolean EleanorDating
You're the monster that I love, Eleanor. I don't regret a thing.
true
I'm starting to think you enjoy saying that about yourself.
true
false
No. Real monsters don't care for people the way that you do.
true
false
+5 Chemistry
If that's what you really believe you are, then Fiendsnight is the perfect chance to celebrate it.
I know you're scared of what you might become. But that's not you NOW.
Oh yes! Silly me. I forgot the monster got the happy ending in our little story.
BE the monster. Own it. For this one night of the year, wear that title with pride.
So dress up. Have fun. Void knows the Hex could all use some.
Forgive me. I still can't quite believe that this is what you actually WANT. Maybe I just need a tiny bit more convincing.
Oh there are SO MANY reasons why that is a TERRIBLE IDEA
I'll take you up on that. And thank you. Once again. x
Let's devour one another later. xxx
SO. MANY.
Chat ends.
Chat ends.
(I can't think of any right now but I'm sure there are DOZENS)
... shit.
you have skewered me most nimbly upon my own kebab. damn you. well done. x
Chat ends.
